items.title: SDG Innovation League
items.role: Head of Operations & Finance, Organising Committee
items.body: A three-phase sustainability innovation competition for secondary school students across Hong Kong, co-organised with HKU Faculty of Education, Ocean Park, and UN SDSN HK. Over 250 students across 17 schools participated to ideate, implement, and pitch SDG projects to industry judges.
bullets: Secured HK$350K+ in sponsorship from HKU, Ocean Park, and UN SDSN HK through tailored proposals and stakeholder negotiations
Directed end-to-end logistics and operations across all three phases, including a full-day launch event and final judging round
Coordinated 62 staff and volunteers; built registration and communication systems for 250+ participants
Managed event budgeting and expense tracking; delivered on budget and on schedule

items.title: Market Strategy & Expansion: Women's Premium Activewear Brand
items.body: A 9-week consulting engagement for a women's premium activewear brand based in Hong Kong, conducted as part of a 6-person team. Focused on diagnosing brand positioning gaps and identifying growth opportunities across retail and digital channels.
bullets: Led market sizing, competitor benchmarking, customer research, and sales-channel analysis
Benchmarked 6 competitors and ~15 Instagram accounts; synthesised findings from 60+ survey responses, 15 focus group participants, and 2 Causeway Bay site visits to identify positioning gaps
Analysed sales performance across 4 channels and delivered a 25-slide final deck with 3 actionable recommendations on in-store experience, brand messaging, and customer engagement
